layer_1_style.description: High-poly 3D animation style, cinematic CGI, smooth clay textures, soft studio lighting, tactile 'handmade' feel.

layer_3_action.subject: Sauropod whip-like tail morphology
features: Extraordinarily long, tapering tail made of smooth brown clay
Tail is held off the ground, curving gracefully upward
Tactile clay sculpture texture with rounded segments
layer_3_action.action: A low-angle perspective looking down the length of a long dinosaur tail as it stretches away from the camera. The base of the tail is at the bottom of the frame, narrowing to a thin tip in the distance. The body and head are out of frame to emphasize the length of the tail. Background features lush clay-textured ferns and tall pine trees under a clear blue sky. No text.
